caseNameFull: DOOLIN, dba NATIONAL NOVELTY CO. v. KORSHAK, DIRECTOR OF REVENUE
attorneys: Owen Rail for appellants., William G. Clark, Attorney General of Illinois, and John J. O’Toole, Assistant Attorney General, for appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.
